ShortDescription.Value: Organize your assets into thematic libraries, with automatic suggestions and a Find It bridge.

Publish.LongDescription:
**Beta (0.1.0).** Shelve It scans the assets you have installed and organizes them into thematic libraries, so you can build a neighbourhood from a coherent set of buildings, props and decals without hunting for them one by one.
## Features - **Asset scan** of every placeable asset: buildings, props, decals, from the base game and from Paradox Mods packages. - **Suggested libraries**, built automatically from asset metadata: regions and styles, creator packs, themed sets (historic, glass towers, airport, military and more). Accept a suggestion with one click, at any level of the tree. - **Find It bridge**: type `lib:name` in Find It's search to see only the assets of a library. Find It is required. - **Filters** in the style of Find It: type, zone, density, region, theme, asset pack, origin, package, level, lot size. Bulk add or remove the filtered result. - **Palette mode**: a compact view that stays open while you build. Click an asset to place it. - **Community sharing**: publish a library, browse and import other players' libraries, or pass a share code (`SHELVE1:...`) by chat. Missing packages can be subscribed in one step.
## Privacy The community server is contacted only when you open the Community tab or use sharing. It receives your Paradox display name only when you publish a library, plus a random install id. Share codes work without the server. Details: https://shelveit.servermartino.com/privacy
## Italiano Shelve It scansiona gli asset installati e li organizza in librerie tematiche, con suggerimenti automatici, filtri, modalità tavolozza e condivisione con la community tramite codici. Con Find It basta cercare `lib:nome` per vedere solo gli asset di una libreria. Interfaccia in inglese e italiano.
